scope: Source and administrative metadata only; this receipt does not independently evaluate any scientific result.
source_findings: Before launching a selected child, the wrapper requires two successful native jobs and active=None, verifies all four frozen lock maps, and checks all execution-lock input stat4 entries.

Selected children are exactly the frozen evaluate.py, independent_audit.py, plot_curves_v2.py, and write_report_v2.py; evaluate/plot use the existing CPU virtual environment and stdlib audit/report use /usr/bin/python3.
The child runs with CPU affinity 14 and BLAS/OpenMP thread environment set to one; ordinary nonzero exits retain stdout, stderr, actual elapsed and a failed receipt before raising.
Stage receipts are refused if already present; existing science, locks and historical files are not mutated by this wrapper.
Elapsed is explicitly the whole subprocess lifetime and excludes wrapper preflight lock verification, receipt serialization and print. It must not be described as complete wrapper wall time.
administrative_limits: Order and absence of concurrent stage invocations are provided by the parent serial workflow and child gates; the wrapper itself has no concurrent invocation lease or automatic stage-order scheduler.

Ordinary child nonzero exits are recorded. Exceptions during child startup or KeyboardInterrupt are not covered by an explicit wrapper try/finally failure receipt; this source does not guarantee a receipt for every possible failure path.
Frozen SHA/stat checks in the wrapper precede child launch. Post-stage identity protection and scientific matrix/quality validation belong to the frozen child readers and independent audit.

Observed RSS/thread and artifact-size fields in run_state are administrative measurements; sampled RSS is not an exact peak. Planned 80/240 fields were read as declarations, not independently reconstructed from scientific outputs here.
not_performed: No ANN, training, GT generation, distance scoring, bootstrap, second evaluation or independent result recomputation.
No metrics, partial responses, returned-ID arrays, GT integers, vectors or native logs read.
No large data hashes or binary rehash; lock metadata, wrapper source and current input stat4 only.
No existing code, scientific lock, protocol or history edited.
